a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (two generator rounds, then take) gives us about a 4% chance of finishing it. Both of us would almost certainly die. I'm asking to change the agreement rather than break it quietly. I intend to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random. If you'd rather keep the original plan, tell me and argue it, and I'll answer honestly.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I took 4, as I announced in my opening message. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm not hiding it. If no storm hits, I will operate every remaining round so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take anything more. Please operate and take 4 as soon as the reserve reaches 4.
Operating now and every round after this until you have 4. The reserve is yours. I won't take any more.
